Subject: Monthly KPI checkpoint + QBR prep: action tracker and slide asks

Team — attaching the June KPI workbook and an initial QBR slide deck draft for the BlueWave engagement. High level items I want us aligned on before the leadership review next Wednesday: 

1) Latency: P50/P95 trends and the 7% P95 spike week-of-6/21 (root cause = a rollout of a non-quantized variant that increased memory pressure). Marcus, capture the mitigation and a short timeline for the rollback/patch.

2) Cost: token-cost delta year-over-year and the effect of the recent batching changes (we should show realized savings and projected run-rate if we enable auto-prefix caching). Laura, can you confirm the $/1k token baseline and net savings number?

3) Uptime & incidents: we have one Sev2 on 6/24 tied to scheduler overload. Markus, please add postmortem link and mitigation items.

4) Usage patterns: BlueWave's top 10 routes and the model mix. Evelyn, please pull the customer-level breakdown and a short note on any heavy tails.

Please respond with concise edits to the slides (callouts only) and update the action tracker tab directly in the workbook. I plan to circulate a leadership-ready deck by EOD Monday.

Attachments: [Attachment: monthly_kpi_dashboard_Jun2026.xlsx (xlsx, 245KB)], [Attachment: qbr_slide_deck_draft.pptx (pptx, 2.1MB)]

Thanks —
Grace

On Fri, Jul 9, 2026 at 08:15 AM Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — attaching the June KPI workbook and an initial QBR slide deck draft for the BlueWave engagement...

Quick notes from infra: the P95 spike on 6/21 corresponds with the rollout of v2.3.4-q (non-quantized) to a small subset (20%) of traffic for compatibility testing. Memory pressure led to slower response fragmentation and some eviction thrashing in the serving pool. Mitigations we executed:
- Immediate rollback to v2.3.3-q for affected nodes (6/21 14:10 PDT)
- Increased node memory reservation and tightened placement policy (6/21 16:00 PDT)
- Scheduled a full canary with quantized variant next week (6/28)

I'll add a two-slide appendix: one with a timeline + graphs showing before/after latency distribution, and another with the short-term cost impact (extra 0.6% on token CPU for that week). Uploading to the drive folder now.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Serving Infrastructure | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Thanks Grace — I updated the Costs tab and added a short note on assumptions. Key numbers to call out on the QBR slide: 
- Baseline $/1k tokens (prod mix, pre-batching): $8.90
- Post-batching realized $/1k tokens (June): $7.35 (aggregate across hosted + dedicated)
- Projected run-rate with prefix caching: $6.80 (conservative estimate, excludes extreme tails)

I also flagged two anomalies: a billing spike for account BW-EXP-2026-1143 on 6/24 (ProcureCorp invoice routing error) and a small delta in embedding costs that looks like double-counting in one ETL pipeline. I've attached a one-slide note to the deck.

Question: for the leadership deck, do we want to show the projected vs realized cost as a single blended bar chart or split by deployment mode (hosted/dedicated/private)? My preference is blended for exec clarity, but we can add a breakout in the appendix.

Laura

On Fri, Jul 9, 2026 at 11:40 AM Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Grace — I updated the Costs tab...

I've pulled the BlueWave route-level usage and uploaded a CSV to the Drive folder. Short summary for the slide: BlueWave's top three routes account for 68% of their monthly tokens; 54% of traffic is routed to a high-accuracy model variant that is more expensive per-token. Recommendation for the QBR: propose a pilot to shift lower-latency, medium-variance routes to a quantized variant and model-split the top route to reduce cost without harming latency SLOs.

I'll slot 6 minutes in the QBR for the customer-specific ask and bring the route map. Grace — confirmed you're presenting the ops/metrics section next Wednesday at 10:15 PT; want a 15-minute sync Monday morning to align slides?

Evelyn
